_comment: Foraging missions, one list per material - every character foraging that material draws from the whole list. Each mission repeats its material (familyId) so a line reads on its own; it must match the list it sits in. "activity" is the material's foraging name; "headlines" name each profession group's foraging (shown above the sites). Mission ids are stored with running trips - keep them.

missions.text: A dead collector's oddities, sold by the lot.

missions.text: Look only at the ground. Collect the shed.

missions.name: Wisp Marsh Residue
missions.text: Phosphorescent dust where the wisps died out.

missions.text: The den was cleared. Its leftovers were not.
